decisions.reason: This non-maritime recruitment line sits far from the firm's ship-management core and has shown no quantified results after two years, but a recruitment service built on existing crewing capabilities costs little to keep open while its value is still uncertain.
Superyacht crew recruitment draws directly on the firm's core crewing network and is cheap to maintain, so the option is worth holding even though results are not yet visible.
The academy grew to six partner institutions within months of launch, an early positive signal that justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
FuelEU monitoring is regulation-driven demand, and the firm met the compliance deadline for all vessels, showing value already realized.
The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software, so keeping it costs little, and FuelEU compliance needs will keep growing, so the option stays open.
The cost simulator is a low-cost add-on within PAL whose value will become clearer as FuelEU penalties take effect, so it is kept as an option.
